description: Named Slavah on the panel: it receives the clock and reset that Mastah broadcasts, as UDP messages on port 7000, and turns them back into pulses; one of these runs on each computer being synchronised

params.text: Closes and reopens the network socket, and sends a pulse from reset

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse for each clock message received
A 1ms 10V pulse for each reset message received

notes: The status lamp lights red if the network socket cannot be opened
Nothing comes out unless a Mastah somewhere on the same network is broadcasting to port 7000
The socket sometimes fails to open when the module is added, and the module then receives nothing; the panel's button reopens it, and closing the patch and opening it again also clears it
